question: What liberation and companionship result from this sustained practice?
premises: The practitioner becomes freed from all diseases
The practitioner gains association with yogis
Union with yogis is presented as an outcome
inference: Through this practice one becomes free from all diseases and attains union with yogis.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of saha+melakam is compressed; read as attaining union.
plain_english: Freed from all diseases, he attains union together with the yogis.
